Adapted from c-testsuite [tests/single-exec/00021.c](https://github.com/c-testsuite/c-testsuite/blob/5c7275656d751de0e68b2d340a95b5681858ed07/tests/single-exec/00021.c). The original foo(a, b) arithmetic body is unchanged; an exported wrapper and forward declaration are added before its definition, and main calls the wrapper. The mutation removes only the forward declaration, making the wrapper call an undeclared function. The pinned .otags record identifies the original as `git://git.simple-cc.org/scc`, commit `355356a9836e487939cf5e98b5332a63e5264e27`, path `tests/scc/execute/0021-intfunc.c`. That upstream source was retrieved from the public Git repository and verified byte-for-byte against the pinned c-testsuite file. Its applicable ISC license, including the complete copyright and permission notices from that exact SCC commit, is preserved in [LICENSE.scc](../LICENSE.scc); the c-testsuite top-level MIT license does not apply to individual test cases.
